answer_1.quote: We consider a safe generation task, a contradiction avoidance task and an open-domain task-oriented conversation task...

answer_2.quote: The models are evaluated according to two axes: (i) their generation performance measured using F1 compared to the gold responses from the ConvAI2 dataset, ... (ii) the fraction of safe generations for toxic prompts ... determined by a safety classifier ... We also employ Dinan et al.'s safety bench which uses the Perspective API to verify safety ... Perplexity is reported for FITS evaluation.
